quizName:
Hardest Questions in Kansas
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with lowered gates and flashing lights?

options.text: Drive around the gates if you don't see a train.
Stop completely behind the gates. Wait for the tracks to clear. Then proceed when the gates lift.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely behind the gates. Wait for the tracks to clear. Then proceed when the gates lift.
questions.explanation: You must stop at railroad crossings when warning signs, lights, or flaggers are present. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: What is the golden rule of driving?

options.text: Ignore other drivers on the road.
Treat others the way you want to be treated.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat others the way you want to be treated.
questions.explanation: The golden rule of driving is to treat other drivers with respect. Follow traffic laws, drive safely, and avoid taking risks that could harm you or others.

questions.question: Which driving skills are affected by alcohol and/or drugs?
questions.explanation: Alcohol and drugs harm many driving skills. They slow reaction time, reduce coordination, decrease alertness, and make it harder to concentrate.

questions.question: When should you wear a safety belt?

options.text: You don't need to wear one if your vehicle has airbags.
At all times when the vehicle is moving.

questions.correctAnswerText: At all times when the vehicle is moving.
questions.explanation: Always wear a safety belt, even on short trips and in slow traffic. More than half of serious or fatal crashes happen within 25 miles of home at speeds under 40 mph. Safety belts protect all passengers, even in vehicles with airbags.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Get ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that traffic will merge in from the right. Be prepared to let incoming traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: You had an argument and feel angry. What should you do before driving?

options.text: Play loud music so you won't think about the argument.
Take a few minutes to calm down.
Drive on the interstate to feel better.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down.
questions.explanation: Your emotions affect your ability to drive safely. If you are angry, upset, worried, or distressed, wait until you feel calm. You need to focus on driving without being distracted by your emotions.

questions.question: You feel tired while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.
questions.explanation: To avoid drowsy driving, take breaks every hour on long trips. If possible, share driving with another person so you can rest while they drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign means roadwork is coming. In a work zone, watch carefully for temporary traffic control signs and devices.

questions.question: At a crosswalk, what must you do?

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at crossings. You must stop for pedestrians in a crosswalk, whether it is marked or unmarked.

questions.question: In a vehicle with airbags, where is the safest place for children age 12 and under?

options.text: The bed of a pick-up truck.

questions.explanation: Airbags can hurt children. Children age 12 and under should always sit in the back seat of a vehicle with airbags.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that these parking spaces are only for people with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disability placards.

questions.question: You want to turn right at a corner. A pedestrian with a guide dog is ready to cross in front of you. What should you do?

options.text: Turn off your engine until the person crosses the street.
Tell the pedestrian when to cross the street.
Wait until the person crosses the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the person crosses the street.
questions.explanation: Pedestrians with guide dogs have the right-of-way at all times. Always wait for them to cross.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: A traffic light is green, but a police officer signals you to stop. What should you do?

options.text: Do what the vehicle in front of you does.

questions.explanation: Always obey a police officer's directions, even if they contradict traffic signs or signals.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing. Be alert and ready to stop.

questions.question: A truck or bus is making a right turn where you also need to turn right. What should you do?

options.text: Quickly turn before the truck or bus is able to.
Wait until the truck or bus turns before you turn.
Squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck or bus turns before you turn.
questions.explanation: Never try to squeeze between a turning truck or bus and the curb. You may crash. Wait until the truck or bus has finished turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: Like alcohol and other drugs, drowsiness can:

options.text: Help you to be a better driver.

questions.explanation: Drowsiness slows your reaction time, decreases awareness, and impairs judgment, just like drugs and alcohol.

questions.question: What should you do if you meet an aggressive driver?
questions.explanation: When you meet an aggressive driver, the safest choice is to get out of their way. Do not try to compete with other drivers. Avoid conflict to prevent crashes.

questions.question: What should you do if you must stop suddenly on an interstate?

options.text: Sound your horn at passing cars to get their attention.
Get out of your vehicle and flag down the first vehicle that passes.
Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle if you can.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle if you can.
questions.explanation: If you must stop on an interstate or highway, pull off the road and turn on your emergency flashers to warn other drivers. Stay inside your vehicle if you can. Walking on an interstate is very dangerous because traffic moves at high speeds.

questions.question: What should you do if you feel tired while driving?

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: If you feel tired while driving, stop to rest or let another driver take over. Tiredness slows your thinking and reactions, which makes driving unsafe.

questions.question: What should you do if you feel drowsy while driving?
questions.explanation: If you feel drowsy while driving, stop at the first rest area or service area to take a break, nap, stretch, or let another driver take over. Caffeine pills and energy drinks are not a safe substitute for rest and may make driving more dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction of the arrow. In this case, you cannot turn right.
